label: AbiQ system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses an AbiQ type III toxin-antitoxin locus whose protein endoribonuclease and cognate RNA antitoxin module alter early phage mRNA profiles and restrict phage propagation after adsorption.
observations: AbiQ branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual abiQ genes, AbiQ proteins, type III toxin-antitoxin modules without direct Abi evidence, ToxIN systems, AbiE systems, source database rows naming one Abi locus, generic toxin-antitoxin systems, and the broader abortive infection system.
